subject: english

prerequisites.point: パラグラフの構成・ディスコースマーカーを手がかりに、段落の役割と筆者の主張をつかめること
prerequisites.title: 長文読解

prerequisites.point: 対話文・説明文・グラフや資料の読み取りの基本（必要な情報を本文から探す習慣）
prerequisites.title: 長文読解

prerequisites.point: 比較級・最上級・倍数表現を正しく読み、数量の大小や評価の表現を区別できること
prerequisites.title: 比較

extensions.point: 同じ「情報の検索・要旨把握・事実と意見の区別」の力を、音声で聞く場面に広げる
extensions.title: 英語リスニング　対話と講義の聞き取り

extensions.point: 要旨把握の手順を、二次試験の内容説明・下線部和訳の記述答案に生かす
extensions.title: 英語　和訳・説明問題

extensions.point: 論説文の「主張＋理由＋譲歩」の構成を、自分の意見文を書くときの型として使う

instructions: A から順に取り組み、B 以降は解答解説冊子の「思考の糸口」を読んでから解き直しましょう。

stimulus.content:
Many young people today rarely talk with elderly people outside their own families. To change this, our school started an exchange program with a nearby care home two years ago. Once a month, about 20 students visit the home and spend an afternoon with the residents.

Last year, our school festival tried something new: visitors could pay at food stands with a smartphone app instead of cash. The student council wanted to know whether this change was a good idea, so it asked 150 visitors and 60 student staff members to answer a short questionnaire.

The results were mostly positive. Of the visitors, 72% said that paying with the app was faster, and the staff no longer had to count coins at the end of the day. One staff member said, "It saved us at least an hour of work."

On the other hand, not everyone was happy. Some older visitors did not have the app, so they had to wait in a separate line to pay in cash. A few stands also had trouble when the Internet connection became slow in the afternoon.

I believe cashless payment should continue at this year's festival, but cash should still be accepted. That way, the festival can become more convenient without leaving anyone out.
